neonlyrics.tut.s0.title: Lyrics in the sky
neonlyrics.tut.s0.text: Tip: on Windows you don't need any of this – switch to "Automatic" at the top. This guide is for Mac/Linux or if Automatic doesn't work: you need a small Spotify app of your own, free and quick to make.
neonlyrics.tut.s1.title: 1. Open the dashboard
neonlyrics.tut.s1.text: Click "Open dashboard" below and log in with your Spotify account. Then click "Create app" at the top right.
neonlyrics.tut.s2.title: 2. Fill in the app
neonlyrics.tut.s2.text: Name and description don't matter. Paste exactly this address under "Redirect URIs", press "Add", tick "Web API", accept the terms, "Save".
neonlyrics.tut.s3.title: 3. Copy the client ID
neonlyrics.tut.s3.text: Open your new app and go to "Settings". Under "Basic Information" you'll find the Client ID – copy it. You don't need the "Client secret".
neonlyrics.tut.s4.title: 4. Paste & connect
neonlyrics.tut.s4.text: Paste the client ID below (Ctrl+V) and click "Connect". Your browser opens – agree there.
neonlyrics.tut.s5.title: Done! Problems?
neonlyrics.tut.s5.text: While a song plays, lyrics show in the sky and at the top. On the right are the most common errors and how to fix them.
neonlyrics.tut.fix1: The redirect URI must be exactly http://127.0.0.1:8789/callback. Don't forget "Add" and "Save".
neonlyrics.tut.fix2: Add your Spotify e-mail under "User Management" in the dashboard.
neonlyrics.tut.err3: Browser shows an error / nothing happens
neonlyrics.tut.fix3: Port 8789 in use? Restart Minecraft and click "Connect" again.
neonlyrics.tut.fix4: Not every song has synced lyrics on lrclib.net. Try a popular song or the demo.
